finding.scope: New dedicated native harness SDK child cleanup; original narrow CLI/App child fixes remain separately valid
finding.trigger: Actual SDK stdio child starts, then initialize/handshake fails or outer connect timeout occurs. SDK automatic close may already be in flight when harness finally invokes close again.
finding.confirmed_source: SDK close clears its process reference before waiting; after two bounded waits it may SIGKILL and return without final close await. LegacyHandshake catch invokes this.close unawaited. A second close can return immediately because SDK process field is already cleared. Harness ignores finally close errors and allClosed covers only CLI/App, so it can remove owned data while SDK child/first close is still live or unobserved.
finding.happy_path_boundary: Transport onclose observer is actual child close in pinned stdio implementation, but current marker is lexical/happy-only and ownership is cleared before its assertion. It cannot protect failure cleanup.

primary_sdk_facts: start resolves spawn and rejects error; only child close invokes stdio transport onclose
Public pid is getter of current process reference and becomes null when close clears it
Client.close delegates to transport close and resets client state; it does not add actual process-close await
Public stdio close is not internal _dispose; _dispose uses process exit and is not a supported public lifecycle replacement
Default versionNegotiation is legacy at index2559-2567, matching current harness Client call
actual_checks: Read-only actual frozen harness and installed SDK source/package SHA reads
Bounded source trace of spawn/error/close, Client connect/automatic close/base Protocol callback chaining and close delegation
not_run: SDK imports or Node/native harness execution
Any allocation/process latency or actual leftover measurement
qualification: Static concrete failure path, not an observed leaked process. Existing source reviews retain their original scoped meaning; new runtime-safe driver must not rewrite frozen297 inputs.
